name: Cable Kneeling Single-Arm High Row
steps: Take a half-kneeling stance facing a high pulley and reach up with one hand for its handle.
Pull your elbow down and back until your hand approaches the side of your chest.
Reach up along the cable's path until your arm extends.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your shoulders square to the pulley.
Avoid leaning backward or shrugging your working shoulder as you pull.
